author: vladthegreat100
body: I am sorry to announce that Atomic Warriors have officially been disbanded. We have been way too inactive and in the past weeks our members have been leaving to make new groups by themselves. Me and Porky might be making another team later in the year but with different people since the team was mostly the original fancy soldier team who left due to many players and joined our team. If me and Porky do NOT make a new team we will be applying for different groups. So may all the Atomic Warrior Team have luck in the future tournaments and for all to have luck in their Avicus Journey.
